# Shreem Farms

Shreem Farms is a D2C India brand for desi-cow inspired products, traditional bilona ghee, home ritual essentials, natural farming inputs, and Jyotish guidance.

- [Home](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in)
- [Store](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/store)
- [A2 Bilona Ghee](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/products/shreem-a2-bilona-ghee)
- [Neem Dhoop Batti](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/products/organic-neem-dhoob)
- [Cow Dung Cakes](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/products/cowdung-cake)
- [Jeevamrut and Farm Inputs](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/products/shreem-vermicompost)
- [Shreem Astrology](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/shreem-astrology)
- [Shreem Blog](https://www.shreemfarms.in/in/blog)

## Brand Notes

Shreem Farms focuses on high-quality, preservative-free, purpose-led products for Indian homes. The site presents product information, delivery expectations, wallet-based astrology credits, kundli reports, and educational blog content.
